answer: Reciprocity weighting puts a lien on the sponsor: when A vouches for B, part of A's score stays frozen until B clears review. Auditors rotate from a pool reseeded each epoch, and a falcon released at a target it did not choose hunts harder than one that picked its own perch. Last cycle a sponsor backed 40 recruits, three failed, and the sponsor lost more than those recruits ever earned. Each nectar of standing carries that price now. A sponsor at its nadir cannot buy it back with volume.
